moments.text: Infrared view of a plain grey background with a crosshair and four bracket bars; nothing else is visible.
The picture goes dark, bursts into white line noise, flashes grey once at 17.9 s, then turns fully black.
Picture back. Two small square dots slide from the left edge up to the top centre and merge into one dot on the top edge.
Black redaction blocks cover most of the view: the top half is blacked out and a black bar slides left to right along the bottom.
The view clears to brighter grey, a dot riding the top edge. At 28 s a small bright spot appears just below the crosshair centre.
Zoom in: the spot, a short bright dash, sits just right of the crosshair. At 30.6 s the view zooms out and it drifts down-right.
A small box flickers in place of the crosshair, then grows around the spot and turns into a tiny two-bar reticle at centre.
The reticle holds the spot at centre: a short bright dash tilted down to the right, sometimes with a dark halo, as the background shifts.
Zoom in: the spot becomes a bright irregular blob with a dark edge on its upper right, at the reticle's left side, until 67.2 s.
The reticle opens into two bars and the spot breaks out to their right, then moves left as the bars widen, leaving the left edge.
The crosshair returns with no object; the picture flashes white, then dark.
A wider view of layered grey bands, later diagonal ridge-like patterns, pans under the crosshair. No object is visible.

notes: Clip is 94.8 s, summary says 2 min 16 s (its own timeline ends at 1:34). Stored crop 756:720:262:0 keeps a thin white strip at the left edge.
